rationale: The evidence states: "Like Bill, Alexander Skarsgård played the lead role in the television series True Blood." The grammatical construction "Like [Person A], [Person B] did [Action]" presupposes that Person A also performed the Action. Therefore, the text explicitly entails that Bill (Skarsgård) played the lead role in the television series True Blood, just as Alexander Skarsgård did.
review_note: Comparative clause shares exact True Blood role with Bill.
